findings.detail: AxonDaemon.start() initializes MT5, checks realtime_execution_mode, cold-starts state from historical bars, starts tick engine, enters event loop

findings.finding: Order execution routes through trade_executor via send_order()
CONFIG KEY MISSING: realtime_execution_mode not defined in default_config.py
findings.detail: Code uses config.get('realtime_execution_mode','direct') but key never defined in defaults. Must be set explicitly or defaults to 'direct' mode.
findings.impact: If direct mode used without active MT5 terminal, orders will fail. If bridge mode intended, must be explicitly configured.

findings.finding: Entry signal generation requires complex 5-state machine
findings.detail: EntryStateMachine: IDLE→ANOMALY→ARMING→TRIGGERED. Only TRIGGERED state (is_valid_entry=True) triggers execution. Requires: anomaly detection + absorption/decay + impulse breakaway (>1.5 pips)
findings.impact: If market lacks microstructure anomalies today, no entry signals will generate, blocking all trades.

findings.finding: Execution bridge available but may not be running
findings.detail: Bridge service on port 8766 available. Requires: python windows/execution_bridge.py --port 8766 --path 'C:\Program Files\MetaTrader 5\terminal64.exe'
findings.impact: If bridge mode enabled and service not running, all orders fail with WebSocket connection error.

recommendations: IMMEDIATE: Check daemon logs to see if realtime_execution_mode is set. If not, add to config (decide: 'direct' or 'bridge').
DEBUG: Monitor EntryStateMachine state transitions in logs. Check if TRIGGERED state ever reached today.
DEBUG: If direct mode, verify MT5 terminal running. If bridge mode, start execution_bridge.py service.
ANALYSIS: Review velocity/displacement metrics. If all ticks normal, anomalies won't trigger.
VERIFY: Check cooldown elapsed, risk guard not tripped, trading not paused.
